fact: ODI says that in 2024-2025 the national government, with World Bank support, launched a national property tax administration system deployed locally but managed centrally by the Ministry of Finance's Fiscal Decentralization Division, adopting Moptax 2.0 and deploying it in Kenema, Freetown and Makeni.
title: Local leadership for digitalising public administration: lessons from property tax reform in Freetown, Sierra Leone
